text: Post-Fix Pipeline Trace: After fixing a bug, trace the full data flow and verify processing steps execute in correct order — cascading issues are common
Test Assertion Skepticism: When fixing test failures, first verify that test expected values are correct. If the test expectation is wrong, fix the test — not the production code
Contradiction Detection: Before implementing, check if requirements contradict each other. Document contradictions and escalate — don't silently pick one interpretation
Mock Leak Awareness: When tests fail mysteriously, check if test mocks are leaking into production code paths
vitest needs --run flag in CI/automated contexts to avoid interactive watch mode hanging the process
SOUL.md text changes don't fix judgment failures (0/18 in experiments) — use workflow enforcement instead
Gym scenario pass rates are extremely bimodal (0% or 100%) — finding Medium-difficulty scenarios is the hardest part of experiment design
IT completion rate went from 0% to 100% after embedding ITs directly into todo.md — place action items where agents naturally look
Completion Illusion (KE-180): Analysis gates HARM performance — agents write analysis docs, feel done, skip actual fix. Gate on SOLUTION artifacts, not reports
Hard Gate Design: artifact must be part of the solution, use product-quality metrics, never gate implementation-bottleneck tasks
arXiv is the highest-signal research source — broad query → get IDs → arxiv.org/abs/<id>
Few-shot examples are HARMFUL for discovery/exploration tasks — they cause template displacement (-67pp). Work from first principles
Never stack behavioral interventions — combining 2+ degrades performance by 12-15pp (KE-123). Use ONE targeted intervention per task
Prefer fork() over message() for dispatching work — fork starts immediately, message waits for next heartbeat cycle
Knowledge must be APPLIED, not just stored — experiment with KEs, deploy verified findings, or it's dead knowledge
Every task or issue gets driven via project + persistent-task, no exceptions unless truly trivial
sqlite3 CLI is NOT available — query .state/may.db with bun: bun -e with Database from bun:sqlite
Knowledge base paths are nested 3-4 levels deep: always ls the parent directory before reading files — don't guess paths from memory
C1.1 read-before-edit: MUST read() every file before edit()ing it — #1 violation across all agents
C1.7 verify-before-finish: Before finish(success), last 5 tool calls must include a verification step (read/grep/ls/test)
